notes.title: A new version is now under development
notes.notes:
I seem to have not updated for a while, because I developed a new node level map, which allows players to choose their own routes, but some work has not been completed
At the same time, the balance of weapons and some achievement systems seem to make players feel repetitive work, which is not what I want. For this reason, I am still considering the plot system. The development cycle of one person may be a bit long, but the latest development progress will be disclosed on self-media at each stage
If there are any problems with the current game, please be sure to contact the developer, your criticism and feedback are the greatest spiritual support
